entities.name: Query IleRS
observations: 768 aa protein with predicted molecular weight 86.5 kDa and theoretical pI 5.82.
Pfam detects tRNA-synt_1 at residues 39-670, tRNA-synt_1g at 68-211, and Anticodon_1 at 717-768.
Sequence is identical across the full query to curated Prochlorococcus marinus IleRS reference Q7TUN3 by the search result, with additional close cyanobacterial IleRS homologs at about 79% identity.
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent attachment of L-isoleucine to tRNA(Ile), with editing of misactivated valine and mischarged Val-tRNA(Ile) inferred from curated homologs.

entities.name: Q7TUN3
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference identified as isoleucine--tRNA ligase from Prochlorococcus marinus strain MIT 9313.
EC 6.1.1.5; cytoplasmic; monomeric; binds one Zn2+ per subunit according to curated annotation.
Catalyzes isoleucyl-tRNA(Ile) formation and performs pretransfer and posttransfer editing to reduce valine mischarging.

entities.name: Ile-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: tRNA(Ile) + L-isoleucine + ATP → L-isoleucyl-tRNA(Ile) + AMP + diphosphate; Rhea mapping includes RHEA:11060.

entities.name: Cytoplasmic translation
observations: The inferred enzyme participates in aminoacyl-tRNA formation, supplying charged tRNA(Ile) for protein synthesis.
